verdict.rationale: The pack lists first-party docs for Bits AI (Datadog's AI assistant) and Watchdog (its automated detection feature), which points to AI-assisted investigation. However, the evidence is only page titles and never states that either feature investigates an alert or error and proposes a probable root cause. missing for 10: documented AI investigation of alerts/errors, explicit root-cause proposal capability, workflow details linking monitors or incidents to AI analysis, independent or hands-on corroboration.
